defects.description: Figure FLOATING — feet at y=+0.328 (chest level), not on ground. Description: "Lean the back against the wall and lower into a partial squat". Without globalTilt, body remains upright at standing height with legs folded up (feet elevated). Balance section confirms floating=true. Need globalTilt to recline back against wall and lower body into squat.

Arms asymmetric: leftElbow=80°, rightElbow=20°. Description says "Rest BOTH forearms loosely on the thighs". Asymmetric elbow bends produce asymmetric forearm rest. Right arm too straight to rest forearm on thigh.

Forearm-to-thigh contact not achieved. shoulderFwdL=-1, shoulderFwdR=-5 (near-zero forward) — arms hang at sides, not reaching forward to rest on thighs. Wrists at x=±0.5 (out to sides), thighs at x=±0.13 — wrists 0.4m lateral of thighs. For forearm-on-thigh, shoulders must flex forward (shoulderFwd negative) so elbows come forward over thighs.

failing_tests.expected: symmetric elbow bend for both forearms on thighs

regression_risk: medium — 4 fields, single-pose. globalTilt:-25 reclines whole body back against wall (lowers hips toward squat). Without rendering verification, exact foot position after tilt is uncertain — may still be slightly elevated. rightElbow:20→80 matches left for symmetric forearm rest. shoulderFwdL/R:-25 swings arms forward over thighs. spine:-12 preserved (back arch against wall ✓). leftHip/rightHip:60 preserved (thigh forward for squat). leftKnee/rightKnee:90 preserved (right-angle bend ✓).
rationale: Description: "Lean the back against the wall and lower into a partial squat, knees tracking directly over the toes. Rest both forearms loosely on the thighs". Cron-round-9 correctly fixed spine 12→-12 (back arch), but the figure still floats because no globalTilt is set. globalTilt:0→-25 reclines body backward (CORRECTED CONVENTION: -90=supine, so -25 = partial recline back against wall), lowering hips into partial squat and bringing feet toward ground. rightElbow:20→80 matches leftElbow:80 for symmetric forearm rest on both thighs. shoulderFwdL/R:0/-5 → -25 swings upper arms forward so elbows come over thighs, allowing forearms to rest on thigh surface (CORRECTED CONVENTION: shoulderFwd - = FORWARD). Together these bring forearms from sides (x=±0.5) to over thighs (x=±0.13). Note: full ground-contact verification requires rendering; proposed values are best-estimate FK projections.
